title: Qt: Allow omitting secondary data sources when printing
description:
Add a checkbox to the packet format group box to allow the
hexdump to only have the main frame instead of secondary data
sources as well, so that Print and Export Packet Dissections can
be used for input to text2pcap.

notes.body: There's a little bit more to do to make this work on Windows, I believe, but I don't know Windows GUI programming.

Qt: Allow omitting secondary data sources when printing

Add a checkbox to the packet format group box to allow the
hexdump to only have the main frame instead of secondary data
sources as well, so that Print and Export Packet Dissections can
be used for input to text2pcap.
